item.title: CORRECTIONS/CLARIFICATIONS
item.description: An article in the Feb. 11 edition of The Leader incorrectly reported that moving to single-stream recycling would require the City of Port Townsend to purchase a $500,000 truck. Trucks used for garbage collection and recycling are, and will continue to be, purchased, owned and operated by Waste Connections. The post CORRECTIONS/CLARIFICATIONS first appeared on Port Townsend & Jefferson County Leader.

item.description: Authorities confirmed that a kayaker reported missing on Feb. 20 has been found dead following a multiday search involving multiple agencies. item.description: Jefferson Transit Authority (JTA) will reintroduce Sunday bus service later this year as part of a pilot program to address a frequently requested gap in transit availability.
